description: The dataset records river sediment samples collected from two sections of the Chiba region, the Ono River and the Yuki River. Each record includes a textual Event and Sample ID that serve as aggregation keys, a numeric Section measurement ranging from -0.15 to 146.27, and an archaeological Age value from 0 to 1310 years. Environmental SR values span 0 to 242. Geographic coordinates are provided (latitude 35.27 N, longitude 140.29 E). Bibliographic references attribute the data to the current study or Kuwano et al. (2021). The missing Date/Time field indicates no temporal stamp. Researchers can use these measurements to assess sediment composition, provenance, and historical deposition patterns in riverine environments.
